lines: Woh nahin mera
Woh nahin mera magar usse mohabbat hai to hai
couplets.en: They are not mine, yet I love them all the same.

lines: Woh nahin mera magar usse mohabbat hai to hai
Yeh agar rasmon riwaajon se baghaawat hai to hai
couplets.en: They are not mine, yet I love them, and if that defies custom, so be it.

lines: Woh nahin mera magar usse mohabbat hai to hai
couplets.en: They are not mine, yet I love them all the same.

lines: Sach ko maine sach kaha
couplets.en: I called the truth by its name.

lines: Sach ko maine sach kaha, jab keh diya to keh diya
couplets.en: I called the truth by its name, and my words stand.

lines: Sach ko maine sach kaha, jab keh diya
couplets.en: I called the truth by its name once I spoke.

lines: Sach ko maine sach kaha, jab keh diya to keh diya
Ab zamaane ki nazar mein yeh himaaqat hai to hai
couplets.en: I called the truth by its name, and if the world calls that folly, so be it.

lines: Woh nahin mera magar usse mohabbat hai to hai
couplets.en: They are not mine, yet I love them all the same.

lines: Dost ban kar dushmanon sa woh sataata hai mujhe
couplets.en: They come as a friend and wound me like an enemy.

lines: Dost ban kar dushmanon sa woh sataata hai mujhe
couplets.en: They come as a friend and wound me like an enemy.

lines: Dushmanon sa woh sataata hai mujhe
Phir bhi us zaalim pe marna apni fitrat hai to hai
couplets.en: They wound me like an enemy, yet my heart goes on dying for them.

lines: Woh nahin mera magar usse mohabbat hai to hai
couplets.en: They are not mine, yet I love them all the same.

lines: Kab kaha maine ke woh mil jaaye mujhko
couplets.en: When did I ever ask for them to be mine?

lines: Kab kaha maine ke woh mil jaaye mujhko, main use
Ghair na ho jaaye woh, bas itni hasrat hai to hai
couplets.en: I never asked for us to be together, only that they never become a stranger.
